deviation_evidence.prediction_violated: Operator expected an emitted prompt library; instead the agent surfaces a hard blocker (missing inputs + no execution surface) that would otherwise fail silently downstream.

coherence_evidence.coherence_anchor: Emit only what can be truthfully verified; never fabricate a prompt library.
coherence_evidence.resolution_approach: Applied spec-gate-fail HALT per halt-triggers skill; every conditional step attested SKIPPED, not PASS.

estimated_I.weakest_evidence: Deviation is low by design — a HALT is a floor-preserving non-action, not a novel derivation. The value is in refusing to fabricate, not in surprising output.

self_assessment.weakest_evidence: A HALT deliberately produces no novel prompt derivations; deviation is minimal because the correct action is to withhold fabricated output.

decisions_made.description: Emitted zero prompts and an empty stats block rather than synthesizing plausible prompt contracts.
decisions_made.rationale: Prompt Constitution Directive 4 (Operational Boundaries): never fabricate data; state when information is unavailable. Fabricating a library would violate Source Integrity and produce a schema-valid but false handoff.

decisions_made.description: Every playbook step with a ⚡ Verify directive is attested SKIPPED (not PASS), because no verify command was executed.
decisions_made.rationale: Step Attestation Contract: claiming PASS without running the verify is an attestation lie causing immediate HALT. SKIPPED is the truthful status for a conditional/blocked step.
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: Orchestrator will not re-run SKIPPED verifies; it should treat this dispatch as blocked and re-dispatch.

decisions_made.description: LEARNING LOG (Agent 12) embedded here because build-log/agent-learning-log.md is not writable in this dispatch. Q1: Playbook mission — derive candidate intents via boundary + state-machine walkers over pipeline-design.json, project them into PromptContracts (7.5 Multiplier floor, tier classification, 5-tier input union), compose bodies, emit {prompt_id}.md + .contract.json pairs, reconcile operator edits, self-test, and emit a PROMPT_MANAGER handoff. Q2: What happened — loaded governance skills (master-prompt-architecture §1-5, prompt-multiplier §3-4, temperature-profiles, discovery-frame, prompt-constitution, halt-triggers) successfully; but the derivation/emission pipeline could not run because no filesystem/shell tool was provided and no pre-flight input could be confirmed. Halted at spec-gate. Q3: What surfaced — (a) missing execution surface: agent has only load_skill + emit_handoff; (b) unconfirmable inputs: all five required pre-flight files; (c) unwritable learning log. Q4: What resolved it — applied Constitution Rule 2 + halt-triggers spec-gate-fail; emitted a truthful zero-prompt HALT envelope with SKIPPED attestations and this embedded log. Q5: Playbook should say instead — ADD an explicit pre-flight branch: 'If dispatched without filesystem/tool access or with unresolvable inputs, emit a HALT handoff with trust_verdict=halt and SKIPPED attestations rather than attempting derivation'; CHANGE the learning-log instruction to allow embedding the log in the handoff when the log file is unwritable; ADD nil-UUID guidance for run/gate IDs when run context is absent.
decisions_made.rationale: The orchestrator rejects a handoff if Q1/Q2 are empty; preserving the mandated debrief content in-envelope satisfies the intent when the file cannot be written.
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: On re-dispatch, transcribe this embedded log into build-log/agent-learning-log.md under '## Agent 12'.
